'''Adega''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the [[War against Zakuul|conflict]] with the [[Eternal Empire]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recruited Adega to join him on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], where he was killed by Imperials during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="TOR" />
